description: Where the labels of the labeling guide that are not in configs/category_taxonomy.json go for the Gate 1 judge (`map`: label -> taxonomy path), and which labels are lines the judge never sees (`exclude`). docs/labeling-guide.md is the human version: the tests keep the two in step (doc_version, and the guide's row of each label ends with its judge path). When a label is added to the taxonomy, remove it here (a test fails until you do).
